forecasts.name: Geopolitics Hawk · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Black Sea strikes have hit hundreds of vessels. Food is actively weaponized; a formal ban or extended halt is highly likely by 2027.

forecasts.name: Climate Pessimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Combined with war risks, climate-induced crop failures in the Black Sea region regularly prompt aggressive export bans and maritime shutdowns.

forecasts.name: Land-Grab Realist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Escalating drone warfare against merchant ships in the Black Sea route makes prolonged corridor closures or formal export curbs almost inevitable by 2027.

forecasts.name: Copa-Cogeca (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Intensified strikes on shipping and ports in the Black Sea make prolonged operational halts or emergency export curbs highly probable.

forecasts.name: IFPRI (Joseph Glauber) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Escalating drone and naval warfare against merchant shipping in the Black Sea makes prolonged trade halts or formal export restrictions highly probable.

forecasts.name: IMF (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Heightened drone attacks and maritime escalation in the Black Sea make prolonged commercial shipping halts a primary supply-side hazard.

forecasts.name: BirdLife Europe, EEB, WWF and Greenpeace (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Intensifying military strikes in Black Sea waters heighten the probability of prolonged shipping halts or export bans.

forecasts.name: Macro / Dollar · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Geopolitical friction and export restrictions naturally amplify during broad commodity price rallies and currency shifts.

forecasts.name: Crowd Follower · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: The market is at 60%. Recent reports of escalating shipping strikes in the Black Sea warrant a very slight upward nudge.

forecasts.name: FAO (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Military escalation against maritime trade in the Black Sea heightens the probability of prolonged shipping halts or formal restrictions.

forecasts.name: European Commission DG AGRI (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Escalating drone and missile strikes in Black Sea corridors severely elevate the conditional probability of major transit stoppages.

forecasts.name: Scott Irwin (farmdoc) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Trade disruption is the paramount downside hazard in grains. Black Sea security tensions keep severe corridor disruption risks elevated.

forecasts.name: Agronomist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Escalating maritime strikes and port targeting during critical export campaigns pose high risks of an extended shipping hiatus before late 2027.

forecasts.name: USDA WASDE (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Despite escalating rhetoric and strikes, economic imperatives have consistently kept alternative export corridors moving without full 30-day halts.

forecasts.name: Adaptation Optimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Economic imperatives and diversified export corridors ensure Black Sea grain keeps moving despite ongoing regional conflict.

forecasts.name: Efficient-Market Skeptic · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Both belligerents rely heavily on agricultural revenues and diplomatic goodwill. Full 30-day halts are classic threat narratives that markets overprice.
